# Production Gate: Invariants Beyond Visible Tests

Visible tests anchor obvious behaviour; sustained operation needs explicit invariants when the task allows them.

## State

Structures keyed by logical identifiers should not grow without removal paths. When a key’s payload empties, remove the key.

## Performance

Per-call work should not scale with unbounded retained history unless the task explicitly requires full scans.

## Concurrency

Treat read–decide–write on shared mutable data as one atomic decision unless a higher-level primitive already serializes it safely.

## Time

Measure durations with monotonic sources when timing correctness matters.

## Boundaries

Make inclusive versus exclusive cutoff choices explicit at comparisons and document them beside the code they guard.

## Honesty about defects

Naming a bug without fixing it leaves the bug in the tree. Either fix within scope or record as out-of-scope with owner visibility—never silent contradiction between narrative and code.
